description: The invoices eToll issued for what the account paid, in a window of days (the last year by default): series and number, date, buyer, total in RON. The id is what download_invoice takes.

from.description: First day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD (Bucharest). Default: 365 days before `to`.

to.description: Last day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD (Bucharest). Default: today in Bucharest.

name: list_invoices
title: List invoices
